pendants.name: Pendants
pendants.intro: Pendants are where timber and light meet most directly. Each shade is turned or built from solid Australian hardwood, so the grain wraps around the light and glows at the thinnest edges. Hang one low over a dining table, or run three along a kitchen bench.
pendants.alt: A slatted timber pendant glowing warm under a timber-framed roof

wall-sconces.name: Wall sconces
wall-sconces.intro: Wall sconces put the light where you live: beside a bed, along a hallway, either side of a mirror. Ours use timber backplates and shields to bounce light softly off the wall, so you see the glow and the grain rather than the globe.
wall-sconces.alt: A linen-shaded wall sconce glowing against a timber-panelled wall

floor-lamps.name: Floor lamps
floor-lamps.intro: Floor lamps are the easiest way to warm up a room without an electrician. Turned timber stems and heavy bases keep them steady and quiet, and a linen shade keeps the light gentle enough for reading late.
floor-lamps.alt: A timber tripod floor lamp glowing in a dim room in the evening

task-lamps.name: Task lamps
task-lamps.intro: Task lamps are for close work: a desk, a reading chair, a workbench. They are compact and precise, with integrated LEDs chosen for accurate colour, and timber bodies you will want to keep within reach.
task-lamps.alt: A timber desk lamp with a glowing slot standing on a desk in afternoon light

candelabras.name: Candelabras
candelabras.intro: Candelabras are our multi-light fittings: several lights carried on a single timber frame or canopy. They are made for kitchen islands, long dining tables and high ceilings, where one pendant isn't enough and a row of separate ones feels busy.
candelabras.alt: Long timber light bars glowing in a row under a dark timber ceiling

tasmanian-oak.name: Tasmanian oak
tasmanian-oak.grain: Straight and even, with fine gum veins
tasmanian-oak.character: Bright, calm and modern. Glows golden when lit from behind.

victorian-ash.name: Victorian ash
victorian-ash.grain: Straight with a clear growth-ring figure
victorian-ash.character: Light and airy. Takes a soft matt finish beautifully.

spotted-gum.name: Spotted gum
spotted-gum.grain: Wavy, with a ripple figure that catches the light
spotted-gum.character: Strong and lively. The figure shimmers as you walk past.

blackbutt.name: Blackbutt
blackbutt.character: Honest and warm. A natural fit for coastal homes.

jarrah.name: Jarrah
jarrah.character: Dramatic and dense. Deepens to a dark red over time.

tasmanian-blackwood.name: Tasmanian blackwood
tasmanian-blackwood.grain: Straight to wavy, with chatoyant figure
tasmanian-blackwood.character: Our most prized species. Deep, lustrous and quietly luxurious.

huon-pine.name: Huon pine
huon-pine.grain: Very fine and close, with bird's-eye flecks
huon-pine.character: Rare, fragrant and soft-gold. Used only for small, special pieces.

river-red-gum.name: River red gum
river-red-gum.character: Bold and characterful, full of figure and movement.

recycled-hardwood.name: Recycled hardwood
recycled-hardwood.colour: Mixed browns with old nail marks
recycled-hardwood.character: Every piece carries a history. No two lights match.

products.name: Cradle
products.short: A turned timber dome that throws a soft pool of light over a dining table or kitchen bench.
products.story: Cradle is turned from a stack of boards glued up face to face, so the glue lines run around the shade like contour lines on a map. Lit from inside, the thinnest part of the rim glows warm and every seam shows. It's the simplest shape in the collection, and the one that shows our approach most clearly.
products.alt: A turned timber dome pendant glowing in a dark timber-lined room

products.name: Daintree
products.short: Fine timber slats around a warm glow, like light through a stack of kindling.
products.story: Daintree is built from dozens of narrow slats, the kind of short, thin lengths that usually end up as offcuts. Each one is sanded by hand and spaced so the light escapes in soft bands. Switched off it reads as joinery; switched on it fills a room with striped shadow.

products.name: Flinders
products.short: An open timber cube with a bare globe at its heart. Joinery you can see straight through.
products.story: Flinders is pure structure: twelve lengths of hardwood joined at the corners with no visible fixings. It is the piece that shows our joinery most honestly, and it looks best hung in a cluster at different heights.
products.alt: An open timber cube pendant with a filament globe inside

products.name: Wollemi
products.short: A linen shade on a timber arm that washes soft light down a wall.
products.story: Wollemi takes its shape from the fold of a sandstone gorge. A short timber arm holds a linen shade close to the wall, so the light spills down in a gentle fan. Mounted in pairs it frames a bed or a doorway.

products.name: Otway
products.short: Two timber wings that shield the globe and throw light up and down the wall.
products.story: Otway wraps the light in two curved timber wings, so it glows from the edges like a coal in a fire. It is our warmest sconce, made for hallways, verandahs and anywhere you want a low, golden light at night.

products.name: Freycinet
products.short: A small fabric hood on a turned timber mount. Quiet enough for a bedroom.
products.story: Freycinet is the smallest light in the range: a turned timber mount the size of your palm and a soft hood that hides the globe completely. Fitted in pairs it reads more like architecture than a fitting.
products.alt: A pair of small hooded wall sconces either side of a plaster archway

products.name: Barrington
products.short: A slender timber stem and linen drum shade for reading corners.
products.story: Barrington stands on a heavy turned base with a single straight stem, so it sits quietly beside an armchair. The linen shade softens the light and lets the timber do the talking.
products.alt: A timber floor lamp with a white linen drum shade against a pale blue wall

products.name: Karijini
products.short: Three timber legs, one generous shade. Our most sculptural floor lamp.
products.story: Karijini stands on three tapered legs that meet just below the shade, like a surveyor's tripod. The legs fold flat for delivery and lock with a single brass pin.

products.name: Daylesford
products.short: A compact reading lamp that tucks in beside an armchair.
products.story: Daylesford is the floor lamp for small rooms. Its shade sits at reading height and its round base slides under the edge of a chair, so the light lands exactly on the page.
products.alt: A slim floor lamp beside an armchair in a reading corner

products.name: Bright

products.story: Bright is two timber leaves standing on a shared base, each one laminated from narrow boards so the seams run the full height. A thin LED strip hides between them, so light falls in a clean band across the desk and the grain is lit from the side.

products.story: Lorne is a short turned stem with a soft white shade on top, small enough for a bedside table and calm enough to leave on all evening. The stem is turned from offcuts of our larger pieces, glued up so the seams show.

products.name: Myall
products.short: A long timber beam carrying a row of lights, made for a kitchen island or a long dining table.
products.story: Myall is a single long beam laminated from narrow boards, with the seams running its full length. Five lights are set into its underside, so the whole table is lit evenly and the beam itself becomes the feature. It hangs from two fine cables and can be made to the length of your bench.

products.short: Three or four turned timber shades hung from one canopy, in a line over a kitchen island.

products.name: Kanangra
products.short: A timber frame with tall glowing rods, built for high ceilings, stairwells and open-plan rooms.
products.story: Kanangra is our largest fitting: a timber frame that carries a series of slim vertical light rods, rising like the cliffs it's named for. It fills a double-height space without blocking the view through it, and works best where you can see it from below.
